name: 群山上的“村T”
overview: After modern fashion designer Qin Qin is accidentally sent back to the 1990s, she assumes the identity of Zhao Qinqin and teams up with Shen Zhiheng, the earnest director of a struggling cotton mill, to revive the factory. As her designs breathe new life into the business, a romance begins to grow—until the arrival of the real Zhao Qinqin threatens to expose her secret and upend everything she’s built.
